title: A strongly tempered Meyer space of countably infinite Hamel dimension
summary: There exists a locally finite carrier Λ in the real line whose whole complex strongly tempered Meyer space has Hamel dimension ℵ₀. Both a tempered distribution and its distributional Fourier transform have local atomic formulas on Λ, with coefficient families whose absolute values are summable after division by some polynomial weight (1 + |x|)^N. The same carrier supports the entire space; finite-dimensional exponent layers prove the rank upper bound and independent original parity modes prove the lower bound.
